decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Deliveries to the site shall be through the existing basement service area by means of vehicles no larger than a 10 metre rigid lorry and from the surface car park immediately to the east of the development by means of vehicles no larger than a 7.5 tonne van.

Condition : 2 - Coaches delivering passengers to or collecting them from the conference centre shall do so in the area shown on the approved plans immediately to the south east of the existing basement delivery area entrance.

Condition : 3 - Within six months of the date of this permission, there shall be provided for use by visitors to the Conference Centre twelve covered cycle parking spaces, using 'Sheffield' style stands in a secure and well supervised location within 50 metres of the entrance that shall be clearly identified by direction signage from the entrances to the Conference Centre. The spaces shall be permanently retained and available for use by visitors to the Centre.

Condition : 4 - The Lampton Park Conference Centre use shall not be carried on outside the following times: 8 am to 12 pm Sunday to Thursday; 8 am Friday to 1 am Saturday and 8 am Saturday to 1 am Sunday

Condition : 5 - The car parking area to the south of Clovelly Road shall not be used other than weekdays between the hours of 8 am and 7 pm and the access control barrier shall be permanently retained to secure this.

Condition : 6 - Within three months of the date of this permission, a Travel Plan covering the operation of the Conference Centre shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Travel Plan shall: 

i) Include a commitment to undertake an iTRACE compliant site audit and staff/visitor travel survey to gauge current travel behaviour (standard audit form and survey available from travelplans@hounslow.gov.uk). The survey shall be repeated every two years for a total period of 5 years (at years 1, 3 and 5) and, if requested in writing, a copy of the survey results shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority.

ii) Provide an action plan setting out (with SMART objectives and targets) how sustainable transport options will be communicated and promoted to staff and visitors - e.g. provision of bus route information, information about cycle training opportunities, cycle parking provision, cycle salary sacrifice scheme, walking promotion, shuttle buses etc. (A full list of recommended measures available from travelplans@hounslow.gov.uk)

iii) In the event that targets are not achieved in year 5, be replaced by a revised action plan including measures intended to achieve the original Travel Plan targets or such other targets as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, taking account of the extent to which the original target has been missed.

iv ) Provide a named travel plan coordinator to travelplans@hounslow.gov.uk. This must be current at all times.

Such a travel plan shall be undertaken and maintained as approved

Condition : 7 - Within one year of the date of this permission, a Travel Plan covering the wider operation of the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
The Travel Plan shall: 

i) Include a commitment to undertake an iTRACE compliant site audit and staff/visitor travel survey to gauge current travel behaviour. The survey must be repeated every two years for a total period of 5 years (at years 1, 3 and 5) and if requested in writing, a copy of the survey results shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority.

ii) Provide an action plan setting out (with SMART objectives and targets) how sustainable transport options will be communicated and promoted to staff and visitors - e.g. provision of bus route information, information about cycle training opportunities, cycle parking provision, cycle salary sacrifice scheme, walking promotion, car park charging etc.(A full list of recommended measures available from travelplans@hounslow.gov.uk)

iii) In the event that targets are not achieved in year 5, be replaced by a revised action plan including measures intended to achieve the original Travel Plan targets or such other targets as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, taking account of the extent to which the original target has been missed.

iv ) Provide a named travel plan coordinator to travelplans@hounslow.gov.uk. This must be current at all times.

Such a travel plan shall be undertaken and maintained as approved

Condition : 8 - The car park hereby approved shall be removed no later than five years from the date of this permisson or at such other later time as shall first be approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The site shall then be reinstated to its former condition within one year of the closure of the car park.

Condition : 9 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of 5 years from the date of this permission.

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other British Standard replacing it.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 10 - Within six months of the date of this permission, details of noise limitation equipment to control amplified noise within acceptable limits have been submitted to an approved in writing by the local planning authority.  This equipment shall be designed to operate at times when any exterior door or window to the room containing the amplification system is kept open.  The details so approved shall be implemented and permanently retained in working order.

Condition : 11 - Within six months of the date of this permission, details of measures to help ensure the personal safety of people visiting the premises as a result of a Secure by Design review shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval and the details subsequently approved shall be implemented within three months of the date of such approval.  The assessment shall include a review of the necessity for: additional Close Circuit Television of both the visitors' car park and the overspill; improved lighting; and pruning of trees to allow more light through.
description: Removal of condition 14 (Removal of overspill car park after 5 years) of permission 00676/88/S23 for erection of a single storey extension and roof terrace to the south elevation to provide conference and dining facilities together with creation of 50 new visitors car parking spaces dated 08/02/2005
